 About The Role
 In this role, you will work as a Senior Data Engineer on a next-generation data platform supporting a broad portfolio of energy-sector products.
You will design canonical and semantic data models, integrate fragmented data sources, build real-time pipelines, and take ownership of the Apache Kafka platform. The role is focused on creating reliable, reusable data foundations for cross-product reporting, analytics, AI/ML, and data observability.
 Responsibilities
Design and maintain canonical and semantic data models across multiple products and data domains
Define data contracts, standards, and integration patterns for heterogeneous systems
Build and maintain batch and real-time data pipelines
Architect, deploy, and administer Apache Kafka clusters
Own Kafka topic and partition design, replication, security, monitoring, capacity planning, and performance tuning
Create data foundations for reporting, analytics, machine learning, and LLM-based capabilities
Implement data lineage, usage tracking, telemetry, observability, and data quality monitoring
Collaborate with product managers, data scientists, and application engineering teams
Define and maintain data dictionaries, integration specifications, and architecture documentation
Drive cross-product data integration in complex and evolving environments
 Requirements
5+ years of professional data engineering experience
Expert-level hands-on Apache Kafka experience, including production cluster setup and administration
Strong experience with Kafka broker configuration, topics, partitions, replication, SASL/SSL, ACLs, schema registry, monitoring, alerting, and performance tuning
Deep expertise in canonical and semantic data modelling
Strong experience integrating data across heterogeneous systems with different schemas, frequencies, and business contexts
Strong SQL and Python skills for production data engineering
Experience designing data platforms for reporting, analytics, AI, and machine learning use cases
Strong understanding of data contracts, integration standards, and reusable data architectures
Excellent technical documentation and written communication skills
Ability to work autonomously and drive solutions in ambiguous environments
Experience with data observability, lineage, telemetry, and data quality monitoring is strongly preferred
Experience with Databricks, Microsoft Fabric, Snowflake, SageMaker, or similar platforms is an advantage
Experience supporting AI/ML pipelines, feature stores, training datasets, or embedding-ready data structures is an advantage
Knowledge of Kimball, Data Vault, and medallion architecture approaches is preferred
Experience with energy, Oil & Gas, or industrial operational data is a strong advantage
